name: Corpus Verification Paths
ascii:
Legend: `[D]` = policy/data, `(O)` = operation. Named code labels map to source.

                         CORPUS INTERACTION AND VERIFICATION
                         ===================================

 [User]
    |
    v
 [D] DomainProfile / DOCUMENT_PROFILE (src/domainProfiles.ts:9-94)
       | selects Corpus kind, Evidence schema, and explorer tabs
       | document mode contributes Sections and persistent Highlights
       ` controls source-code versus sandboxed-Markdown presentation

 (O) FileExplorerPanel.revealEntity (src/components/FileExplorerPanel.tsx:103-214)
       | live bounded tree; match artifact CodeEntity paths to Corpus files
       |
       +-- ordinary file/path --> bounded Corpus list/read below
       |
       `-- associated file/entity --> Evidence range in workspace below

 (O) HighlightsTreePanel (src/components/HighlightsTreePanel.tsx:13-128)
       | group persistent artifact lineage and linked Evidence
       `-- restore artifact + reveal linked source range

                    associated selection / highlight reveal
                                      |
                                      v
 (O) CodeEntitiesPanel.selectEntity / openLinkedAnchor (src/components/CodeEntitiesPanel.tsx:76-194)
       | select CodeEntity ranges, resolve a visible linked path, fetch source
       | validated Evidence anchor; profile controls presentation dispatch
       v
+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
|                    CORPUS - AUTHORITATIVE VERIFICATION SURFACE                 |
|                                                                                |
|  (O) FilesystemCorpusProvider (server/corpus.ts:10-122)                        |
|       canonical-root list/read; reject escapes; serve bounded content          |
|  (O) DiagramApplication.sourceSnippet (server/application.ts:2279-2303)        |
|       validate the Evidence anchor and read its complete document              |
|       overlay captured Evidence lines for comparison with authoritative text   |
|                                                                                |
|       presentation policy selects one verification view:                       |
|       +-- source code --------------------------------------------------+       |
|  (O) SourceCodeView (src/components/SourceCodeView.tsx:179-361)         |       |
|       select/highlight exact lines; reveal compacted spans or mapped nodes      |
|                                                                                |
|       +-- Markdown -----------------------------------------------------+       |
|  (O) TerminalMarkdownView (src/components/TerminalMarkdownView.tsx:13-106)     |
|       render sandboxed Markdown; report outline and active section             |
|       |                                                                        |
|       +-- outline / active section                                             |
|  (O) MarkdownSectionsPanel (src/components/MarkdownSectionsPanel.tsx:76-216)   |
|       build the section tree; select sections; replay recent section jumps     |
+--------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

       line selection / section selection / mapped-source reveal
                                      |
                                      v
 (O) PaneNavigationApi (src/panes/navigation.ts:3-96)
       | activate and focus; delay delivery until a destination handler exists
       | record bounded, deduplicated source/section jump history
       `-- replay previous jump or clear; return to Explorer, workspace, or view
                                      |
                                      +---------------> reversible navigation
